note: Necromancer facing front in a long black robe with a hood. Hood, hair and beard are head; beard/hood bottom y~408 at centre (rising to ~372 at the sides). Collar V, neck, robe, belt, sash and everything down to the hem are torso. The robe hangs to the feet, so hip = hem y~842, and the thighs are hidden (no thigh labels). Only the shins and boots show under the hem: lower leg from y~842, no bend visible; ankles at the instep (left y~880, right y~890). Arms are in wide bell sleeves: left arm (image left) reaches out to the staff, shoulder y~485, elbow halfway y~540, the sleeve ends and the hand (fingers round the staff, x<336) begins. Right arm: shoulder y~455, elbow halfway y~558, the trimmed cuff band y~630-650 is forearm, wrist y~662 where the bare hand begins. Equipment: the skull staff (skull, shaft above the fist, shaft below the fist). The artwork is very dark so seams were read on brightened crops.
